contracts.actual_behavior: Deferred registry factories below fix native entity categories, default dimensions and fire immunity, plus update/tracking settings. Native collision/range queries use effective entity dimensions; reviewed custom dimensions/scales override these defaults. fireImmune is native EntityType admission, not extra armor or potion resistance. Builder labels are retained literally and registry namespace is legendary_monsters; labels do not create separate effects. FallingCloud factories ignore type argument and create their own registered arrow types. Four blockentity factories are restricted to their exact corresponding blocks. Block properties copy the indicated pinned Vanilla block before explicit strength/noOcclusion/noCollision changes: strength(F) uses both hardness and resistance; inherited block behavior remains native. IndestructibleBlock copies Netherite material and adds pistonBLOCK, so its name alone gives no bedrock invulnerability; SomberTrapdoor copies Bedrock. Enderstone strength sharedfloat2.5. No new actor payload inferred from registries. Unregistered Cloud Bread food definition remains distinct from registered Infected Chorus Fruit.
